Hi Nikhil,

We're kicking off a SIG/CAIQ evaluation at Bluegate and need a short-run evidence package focused on your supply chain and residency of subprocessors. Could you confirm the following items and send any supporting artifacts by end of day Wednesday (2026-10-19)?

- Current subprocessor roster with country of processing and classification (prod/staging).
- Any subprocessors with data residency requirements or cross-border transfers and the controls in place.
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (summary or full report) and the date of last audit.
- Completed CAIQ (or A&A report) and any open items.
- Sample KMS provenance or key rotation log for one provider (redacted as needed).

If you have a preferred delivery format (CSV for roster, ZIP for evidence), that works for us. Also share a point of contact for quick clarifications — our review window is tight.

Thanks,
Lauren Morris
Head of Vendor Risk
Bluegate Health
lauren.morris@bluegatehealth.com

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear list. We're able to provide all items you requested. A few quick notes and clarifying questions before we assemble the package: 

1) Roster format: we'll deliver a CSV (column layout: vendor, service, env, country_of_processing, contract_owner, data_class). Is that acceptable?
2) SOC 2: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II summary report (audited 2025-11) and a redacted full report under an NDA. Do you need the full report now or will the summary suffice for initial review?
3) CAIQ: we maintain an up-to-date CAIQ; we'll export the completed answers in JSON + a ZIP of supporting evidence. Any particular CAIQ sections you want prioritized?
4) KMS log: we can include a short redacted sample of key rotation entries and a provenance extract for our main KMS provider.

Internal owners: Soojin (security evidence packaging) will assemble the artifacts and Marissa (procurement/legal) will confirm contractual residency controls. We'll target an initial drop by EOD Wednesday (2026-10-14) for an early look, and the full package by 2026-10-19. 

If that timeline works, please confirm whether we should send the materials to security-assess@bluegatehealth.com or via a secure transfer link.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
